meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing is the final human-required handoff because the maintainer raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成版本号递增、构建校验、git 标签与发布说明生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发版都要手动改版本号、打标签、写发布说明。
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps, build checks, git tags, and changelog generation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release means manually editing versions, tagging, and writing release notes.

howto.what: 它会判断版本该按补丁、小版本还是大版本递增,同步改掉八个配置文件里的版本号,再构建校验、提交打标签、建 GitHub 发布、重新生成 changelog。最后一步 npm 发布需要你自己执行。
howto.when: 当你要把插件的版本按补丁、小版本或大版本往前推时接管,由它走完从改版本号到建 GitHub 发布、生成 changelog 的流程。

say.text: 按 minor 递增版本号并生成 changelog
say.note: 重新生成 CHANGELOG.md 并推送

say.text: 检查八个文件的版本号是否都已经一致

howto.what_en: It decides whether the bump is patch, minor, or major, updates the version string in eight config files, then builds, commits, tags, creates a GitHub release, and regenerates the changelog. The final npm publish is left for you to run.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you want to push a plugin's version forward as patch, minor, or major, and runs the flow from version edits through GitHub release and changelog.

say_en.text: Bump a patch version and run the whole release flow
say_en.note: Updates eight manifests and tags the release

say_en.text: Bump minor and regenerate the changelog
Check that all eight files carry the same version
say_en.note: Uses git grep to compare old and new
